levels.name: Beginner
levels.description: Short, slow dialogues with basic vocabulary. Suitable for first-year English learners.

es.name: Principiante
es.description: Diálogos cortos y lentos con vocabulario básico. Adecuados para estudiantes de inglés de primer año.

levels.name: Elementary
levels.description: Everyday conversations on familiar topics: travel, food, appointments, plans.

es.name: Elemental
es.description: Conversaciones cotidianas sobre temas familiares: viajes, comida, citas, planes.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.description: Slightly longer dialogues that include opinions, advice, problem-solving, and informal workplace language.

es.name: Intermedio
es.description: Diálogos un poco más largos con opiniones, consejos, resolución de problemas y lenguaje informal de trabajo.

levels.name: Upper-Intermediate
levels.description: Reserved for more advanced content (coming soon).
